intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi rode a two-wheeler all by herself! 🚲
But playing too hard (and too much ice cream) has consequences...

scenes.title: The Nosebleed
scenes.caption:
Drip... drip... red drops on Kimi's shirt!
Don't panic — head DOWN, not up!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Tilt your head down. Let's put a tissue on your nose first.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't swallow the blood. Breathe with your mouth.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I have blood on my shirt... 😢

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's okay. Don't worry about anything. It will stop soon.

scenes.title: Too Many Ice Creams
scenes.caption:
One ice cream was yummy.
Three ice creams was... a mistake.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What did you eat before? Looks like you ate too many cold things.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I think I'm going to throw up...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You should lie down and rest. Let me rub your tummy. You'll be fine soon.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Can I have a hot pack on my tummy? Yes, please... ♨️

scenes.title: How Tall Am I Now?
scenes.caption:
A few days of rest later —
back to the doctor for good news!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's measure your height and weight.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I grew! I'm all better AND bigger! 💪

ending.title: Now That's Really THE END!
ending.sub:
All 120 scenes of Kimi's world, in 17 episodes. 🌟
From 'Good morning' to 'Good night' — keep talking, keep growing, Kimi! 💬🌱
